as_told.title: George H.W. Bush had full access to the UFO file and finished off the Soviet Union

plain: George H. W. Bush, the former US president, is said to have been told the truth about unidentified aerial phenomena, the government's term for UFOs. A former Pentagon official named Luis Elizondo says so plainly: Bush senior was briefed into the reality of these objects. The philosopher Jason Jorjani goes further. He says Bush had full access to the UFO file because he was briefed while he was deep inside the national security state. Jorjani ties this to Bush's part in finishing off the Soviet Union, and he brings in Bush's father, Prescott Bush. If true, at least one president knew everything the government knew.
